vocabulary.meaning: 使心情沉重，给…带来沉重压力
笨拙地处理，手忙脚乱地摆弄
资金不足的，经费短缺的

subtitles.en: Good to be with you.
subtitles.zh: 很高兴见到大家。

subtitles.en: I'm Tony Dokoupil.
subtitles.zh: 我是 Tony Dokoupil。

subtitles.en: The breaking news right now-- The governor of New York calling in a special prosecutor to take over that alleged Cornell fraternity rape case-- This is now an active criminal investigation.
subtitles.zh: 现在插播突发新闻：纽约州州长正指派一名特别检察官接管那起康奈尔大学兄弟会涉嫌强奸案——目前这已成为一项正在进行的刑事调查。

subtitles.en: TONY DOKOUPIL: --saying, it's deeply disturbing how campus police handled it.
subtitles.zh: 还说校园警方处理此事的方式令人深感不安。

subtitles.en: Reaction tonight from the young woman's attorney.
subtitles.zh: 今晚我们将听到这位年轻女子的律师的回应。

subtitles.en: Put your hands on your head.
subtitles.zh: 把手放到头上。

subtitles.en: TONY DOKOUPIL: Also tonight, newly-released body cam video showing the arrest of Luigi Mangione after he gunned down UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson.
subtitles.zh: 同样在今晚，新公布的随身摄像头视频显示了 Luigi Mangione 在枪杀联合健康保险公司 CEO Brian Thompson 后被捕的画面。

subtitles.en: What police said when they discovered it was him.
subtitles.zh: 警方发现就是他之后说了什么。

subtitles.en: [BLEEP] him, dude.
subtitles.zh: 去他妈的，老兄。

subtitles.en: TONY DOKOUPIL: That flydubai co-pilot had been banned from flying by Oman for his radical views, according to new reporting tonight, as we're hearing for the first time from the pilot he stabbed.
subtitles.zh: 根据今晚的最新报道，那名迪拜航空副驾驶因激进观点已被阿曼禁止飞行，而我们也是第一次听到被他刺伤的飞行员发声。

subtitles.en: Fire and fury.
subtitles.zh: 愤怒爆发。

subtitles.en: Outraged students take to the streets to protest against conditions at hundreds of public schools.
subtitles.zh: 愤怒的学生走上街头，抗议数百所公立学校的条件。

subtitles.en: And a news reporter hit by an out-of-control car on live TV.
subtitles.zh: 还有一名新闻记者在直播中被一辆失控汽车撞倒。

subtitles.en: What happened next.
subtitles.zh: 接下来发生了什么。

subtitles.en: How you been?
subtitles.zh: 你最近怎么样？

subtitles.en: Good to see you.
subtitles.zh: 很高兴见到你。

subtitles.en: TONY DOKOUPIL: And Steve Hartman On The Road, with a story about the healing power of kindness.
subtitles.zh: 还有 Steve Hartman 的《在路上》，带来一个关于善良的疗愈力量的故事。

subtitles.en: You're an angel.
subtitles.zh: 你真是天使。

subtitles.en: ANNOUNCER: From CBS News Headquarters in New York, this is the CBS Evening News with Tony Dokoupil.
subtitles.zh: 这里是纽约 CBS 新闻总部，这是由 Tony Dokoupil 主持的 CBS 晚间新闻。

subtitles.en: TONY DOKOUPIL: Good evening, and great to have you with us on a Friday night.
subtitles.zh: 晚上好，很高兴周五晚上有你陪我们。

subtitles.en: We begin with that Breaking News today, on the alleged gang rape at Cornell University.
subtitles.zh: 我们先来看今天关于康奈尔大学涉嫌轮奸案的突发新闻。

subtitles.en: The young woman, who claims she was repeatedly assaulted at a frat house on campus, will now have her story reinvestigated by New York's top prosecutor.
subtitles.zh: 这位声称在校园兄弟会房子里被多次性侵的年轻女子，她的案件现在将由纽约最高检察官重新调查。

subtitles.en: Attorney General Letitia James appointed to that role by New York Governor Kathy Hochul today, who said the young woman had been failed by campus police and the local DA, who originally closed the case.
subtitles.zh: 纽约州总检察长 Letitia James 今天被州长 Kathy Hochul 任命担任这一职务，州长说这名年轻女子被校园警方和最初结案的当地地方检察官辜负了。

subtitles.en: As governor, I will not allow anyone to sweep this case under the rug.
subtitles.zh: 作为州长，我不会允许任何人把此案掩盖过去。

subtitles.en: Lilia Luciano spoke with the accuser's attorney today and has new details on the incident.
subtitles.zh: Lilia Luciano 今天与指控方的律师进行了交谈，并掌握了事件的新细节。

subtitles.en: LILIA LUCIANO: Today, a visibly angry New York governor put the Cornell rape investigation into the hands of Letitia James, as a special prosecutor.
subtitles.zh: 今天，明显愤怒的纽约州州长将康奈尔强奸案调查交由特别检察官 Letitia James 负责。

subtitles.en: This young woman had already endured something that is utterly unspeakable.
subtitles.zh: 这名年轻女子已经遭受了完全无法言说的事情。

subtitles.en: And then at every turn, she was failed by people and institutions, with an obligation to protect her.
subtitles.zh: 然后，在每一个节点，她都遭到了那些本有义务保护她的人和机构的辜负。

subtitles.en: LILIA LUCIANO: CBS News has obtained hundreds of pages of documents from the University investigation into what happened to a 20-year-old former student at a frat house in 2024.
subtitles.zh: CBS 新闻获得了数百页大学调查文件，内容涉及 2024 年一名 20 岁前学生在兄弟会房子里发生的事。

subtitles.en: Transcripts show the male students and Jane Doe share conflicting accounts.
subtitles.zh: 笔录显示，这些男学生和 Jane Doe 的说法相互矛盾。

subtitles.en: Some of those men stated Jane Doe didn't appear to be intoxicated, and that she gave consent.
subtitles.zh: 其中一些男子称 Jane Doe 看起来没有醉意，并且她表示了同意。

subtitles.en: But Jane Doe describes the night that turned to horror, with multiple men coming in and out of the room, stating at one point, she felt cornered, saying she was a sex doll for all intents and purposes.
subtitles.zh: 但 Jane Doe 描述了那个变成恐怖的夜晚：多名男子进出房间，她说在某一刻她感到被逼到角落，说自己在实际意义上就像一个性玩偶。

subtitles.en: Later that night, she said she was ushered into a closet by two of the men, saying, quote, "It was just raping."
subtitles.zh: 那天深夜，她说她被其中两名男子带进了一个壁橱，说：“那纯粹就是强奸。”

subtitles.en: She says she was in and out of consciousness.
subtitles.zh: 她说自己当时意识时有时无。

subtitles.en: What was the point of no consent?
subtitles.zh: 不同意的临界点在哪里？

subtitles.en: When was that line crossed?
subtitles.zh: 那条界限是什么时候被越过的？

subtitles.en: She didn't have consent from the time she walked in the door.
subtitles.zh: 从她进门那一刻起，她就没有表示同意的能力。

subtitles.en: She was incapable of consent.
subtitles.zh: 她无法表示同意。

subtitles.en: By the time she hit this frat house, she was completely, completely intoxicated.
subtitles.zh: 等她到了兄弟会房子时，她已经完全、彻底醉了。

subtitles.en: It has been supported and testified to by multiple witnesses who saw her before she went to the fraternity.
subtitles.zh: 这一点已得到多名在她去兄弟会之前见过她的证人的支持和作证。

subtitles.en: LILIA LUCIANO: Attorney Thomas Guiffra filed Jane Doe's civil lawsuit, naming seven former members of the Chi Phi Fraternity and Cornell.
subtitles.zh: 律师 Thomas Guiffra 代表 Jane Doe 提起民事诉讼，将 Chi Phi 兄弟会的七名前成员和康奈尔大学列为被告。

subtitles.en: How many of the accused are accused of actually raping Jane Doe?
subtitles.zh: 这些被告中有多少人被指控真正强奸了 Jane Doe？

subtitles.en: Not all of them.
subtitles.zh: 不是所有人。

subtitles.en: There's four that fall into that category.
subtitles.zh: 有四个人属于那一类。

subtitles.en: We definitely are not claiming that everybody participated in a gang rape.
subtitles.zh: 我们绝不是声称每个人都参与了轮奸。

subtitles.en: We are saying that everybody participated in sexual assaults, and we are saying that certain people participated in a rape.
subtitles.zh: 我们说的是每个人都参与了性侵，而且我们说的是某些人参与了一次强奸。

subtitles.en: LILIA LUCIANO: At Cornell, the allegations still weigh heavily on the campus community.
subtitles.zh: 在康奈尔大学，这些指控仍然让校园社区感到心情沉重。

subtitles.en: EESHAAN CHAUDHURI: I hope that wherever Jane Doe is, she knows that students all across campus are standing up for all victims of sexual violence.
subtitles.zh: 我希望无论 Jane Doe 在哪里，她都知道整个校园的学生都在为所有性暴力受害者挺身而出。

subtitles.en: LILIA LUCIANO: Do you think at one point, she will come forward?
subtitles.zh: 你觉得她会在某个时候公开站出来吗？

subtitles.en: I don't know.
subtitles.zh: 我不知道。

subtitles.en: What I hope for her is, she heals, and she's able to go back to school, and she takes the power back.
subtitles.zh: 我对她的希望是，她能康复，能够回到学校，并夺回主动权。

subtitles.en: Governor Hochul says the attorney general's investigation will not only look at the facts of the case, but also, how it was handled.
subtitles.zh: Hochul 州长表示，总检察长的调查不仅会看案件事实，还会看案件是如何被处理的。

subtitles.en: I asked Jane Doe's attorney if he worries whether Letitia James's appointment carries any political baggage?
subtitles.zh: 我问 Jane Doe 的律师，他是否担心 Letitia James 的任命带有任何政治包袱。

subtitles.en: He says this case has nothing to do with politics, and he thinks that James has the resources needed to dedicate to this case.
subtitles.zh: 他说这起案件与政治无关，并认为 James 拥有投入此案所需的资源。

subtitles.en: CBS News has reached out to all of the accused.
subtitles.zh: CBS 新闻已联系了所有被告。

subtitles.en: Two of the attorneys have come back to us.
subtitles.zh: 其中两名律师已回复我们。

subtitles.en: They've denied the allegations.
subtitles.zh: 他们否认了这些指控。

subtitles.en: All right.
subtitles.zh: 好的。

subtitles.en: Lilia, thank you very much.
subtitles.zh: Lilia，非常感谢。

subtitles.en: Appreciate it.
subtitles.zh: 感谢你的报道。

subtitles.en: We turn now to that newly-released arrest video of Luigi Mangione after he shot and killed UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson.
subtitles.zh: 我们现在来看路易吉·曼吉奥内枪杀联合健康保险公司首席执行官布赖恩·汤普森后最新公布的逮捕视频。

subtitles.en: The footage captures the end of a nationwide manhunt and the reaction of the Altoona Police officers who found him.
subtitles.zh: 这段录像记录下了这场全国搜捕的收尾，以及找到他的阿尔图纳警方的反应。

subtitles.en: Ali Bauman, of CBS New York, with the moments that until now, have only been seen in closed court.
subtitles.zh: CBS纽约的阿里·鲍曼带来这些画面，它们此前只在闭门庭审中才看得到。

subtitles.en: I can tell you it's him because I've been seeing all the pictures.
subtitles.zh: 我敢说就是他，因为那些照片我一直在看。

subtitles.en: ALI BAUMAN: Newly-released body cam footage captured the dramatic moment cops realized they had caught Luigi Mangione in this McDonald's in Altoona, Pennsylvania.
subtitles.zh: 最新公布的执法记录仪画面记录下了戏剧性的一刻：警方意识到他们在宾夕法尼亚州阿尔图纳的这家麦当劳里抓到了路易吉·曼吉奥内。

subtitles.en: What's your name?
subtitles.zh: 你叫什么名字？

subtitles.en: Mark.
subtitles.zh: 马克。

subtitles.en: What is it?
subtitles.zh: 叫什么？

subtitles.en: Mark.
subtitles.zh: 马克。

subtitles.en: Mark?
subtitles.zh: 马克？

subtitles.en: Yes, sir.
subtitles.zh: 是的，警官。

subtitles.en: Mark what?
subtitles.zh: 马克什么？

subtitles.en: Rosario.
subtitles.zh: 罗萨里奥。

subtitles.en: Rosario?
subtitles.zh: 罗萨里奥？

subtitles.en: Someone called and they thought you were suspicious.
subtitles.zh: 有人打电话报警，说觉得你可疑。

subtitles.en: Oh, I'm sorry.
subtitles.zh: 哦，不好意思。

subtitles.en: Do you have your ID on you?
subtitles.zh: 你身上带身份证了吗？

subtitles.en: Yes.
subtitles.zh: 带了。

subtitles.en: You got some family down here or what?
subtitles.zh: 你在这边有家人还是怎么回事？

subtitles.en: No, I'm homeless.
subtitles.zh: 没有，我无家可归。

subtitles.en: Just stand up real quick.
subtitles.zh: 先站起来一下。

subtitles.en: Put your hands on your head.
subtitles.zh: 把手放在头上。

subtitles.en: Put your-- just put your hands on top of your head for me real quick.
subtitles.zh: 把你——就把双手放到头顶上，快一点。

subtitles.en: Put your hands on top of your head for me.
subtitles.zh: 把手放到头顶上。

subtitles.en: You seem a little nervous right now.
subtitles.zh: 你现在看起来有点紧张。

subtitles.en: Why are you nervous?
subtitles.zh: 你为什么紧张？

subtitles.en: ALI BAUMAN: While waiting for reinforcements, they tried to engage him in a conversation.
subtitles.zh: 等待增援的同时，他们试着和他聊了几句。

subtitles.en: You know all this nonsense is about?
subtitles.zh: 你知道这是在闹什么吗？

subtitles.en: Hmm?
subtitles.zh: 嗯？

subtitles.en: Do you know what all this nonsense is about?
subtitles.zh: 你知道这些乱七八糟的事是怎么回事吗？

subtitles.en: I'll find out, I guess.
subtitles.zh: 我猜我很快就会知道吧。

subtitles.en: OFFICER DETWILLER: Hey, listen, man.
subtitles.zh: 嘿，听着，兄弟。

subtitles.en: You're under official police investigation right now.
subtitles.zh: 你现在正在接受警方的正式调查。

subtitles.en: Gave a false name to us.
subtitles.zh: 你向我们报了假名字。

subtitles.en: Again, you're going to be arrested for false ID.
subtitles.zh: 再次告诉你，你会因为使用假身份被逮捕。

subtitles.en: OK.
subtitles.zh: 好。

subtitles.en: OFFICER DETWILLER: Is that your name, Mark Rosio?
subtitles.zh: 这是你的名字吗，马克·罗西奥？

subtitles.en: Rosario?
subtitles.zh: 罗萨里奥？

subtitles.en: No, sir.
subtitles.zh: 不是，警官。

subtitles.en: OFFICER DETWILLER: And what's your real name?
subtitles.zh: 那你真名是什么？

subtitles.en: Luigi.
subtitles.zh: 路易吉。

subtitles.en: OFFICER DETWILLER: Luigi?
subtitles.zh: 路易吉？

subtitles.en: Is that your notebook here?
subtitles.zh: 这是你的笔记本吗？

subtitles.en: You can spell it for this officer here, or write it down.
subtitles.zh: 你可以拼给这位警官听，或者写下来。

subtitles.en: Give him the date of birth, then, too.
subtitles.zh: 把出生日期也告诉他。

subtitles.en: How do you spell your full name?
subtitles.zh: 你的全名怎么拼？

subtitles.en: L-U-I-G-I.
subtitles.zh: L-U-I-G-I。

subtitles.en: Mangione.
subtitles.zh: 曼吉奥内。

subtitles.en: M-A-N-G-I-O-N-E.
subtitles.zh: M-A-N-G-I-O-N-E。

subtitles.en: Date of birth.
subtitles.zh: 出生日期。

subtitles.en: Why are you lying about your name?
subtitles.zh: 你为什么在名字上撒谎？

subtitles.en: OFFICER FOX: You have the right to remain silent.
subtitles.zh: 你有权保持沉默。

subtitles.en: Anything you say can and will be used against you in a court of law.
subtitles.zh: 你所说的一切都可能且将会在法庭上用作对你不利的证据。

subtitles.en: ALI BAUMAN: While escorting Mangione outside, officers searched his bag.
subtitles.zh: 警方把曼吉奥内带到外面时，搜查了他的包。

subtitles.en: Nice looking.
subtitles.zh: 挺好看的。

subtitles.en: OFFICER FOX: [BLEEP] him, dude.
subtitles.zh: 去他妈的，伙计。

subtitles.en: It's [BLEEP] him.
subtitles.zh: 他妈的就是他。
百分之百。

subtitles.en: ALI BAUMAN: He was booked into custody later that day.
subtitles.zh: 当天晚些时候，他被登记收押。

subtitles.en: OFFICER: Do you have underwear on underneath?
subtitles.zh: 你下面穿内裤了吗？

subtitles.en: Yes, I do.
subtitles.zh: 穿了。

subtitles.en: ALI BAUMAN: At the police station, officers strip searched him and found a handwritten note book detailing his movements since the crime.
subtitles.zh: 在警察局，警察对他进行了脱衣搜查，发现了一本手写笔记本，详细记录了他犯罪后的行踪。

subtitles.en: A New York judge ruled, most of the evidence collected in that video would be allowed in a state trial, should that go forward.
subtitles.zh: 一名纽约法官裁定，如果州审判继续推进，那段视频中收集的大部分证据将被允许使用。

subtitles.en: Mangione has pleaded guilty to the federal charges and is expected to be sentenced in December.
subtitles.zh: 曼吉奥内已对联邦指控认罪，预计将在12月被判刑。

subtitles.en: Tony.
subtitles.zh: 托尼。

subtitles.en: Ali, thank you very much.
subtitles.zh: 阿里，非常感谢。

subtitles.en: And we know more tonight about the pilot accused of trying to crash a flight to Tel Aviv.
subtitles.zh: 今晚我们进一步了解到那名被控试图让飞往特拉维夫的航班坠毁的飞行员的情况。

subtitles.en: He had become so radicalized that he wasn't allowed to work as a pilot in his home country of Oman.
subtitles.zh: 他变得如此激进，以至于在祖国阿曼被禁止担任飞行员。

subtitles.en: And we're also hearing for the first time from the heroic captain, who says he couldn't let the plane go down.
subtitles.zh: 我们也首次听到了那位英雄机长的发声，他说他不能让飞机坠毁。

subtitles.en: Here's CBS's Imtiaz Tyab.
subtitles.zh: 以下是CBS记者伊姆蒂亚兹·蒂亚布的报道。

subtitles.en: IMTIAZ TYAB: This video, obtained by CBS News, shows the moment passengers and cabin crew raced to the cockpit.
subtitles.zh: CBS新闻获得的这段视频显示，乘客和机组人员冲向驾驶舱的瞬间。

subtitles.en: One passenger can be heard saying, "He's ex-military"-- I'm ex-military.
subtitles.zh: 可以听到一名乘客说：“他以前是军人”——“我以前是军人。”

subtitles.en: IMTIAZ TYAB: --before shouts of no.
subtitles.zh: 随后传来“不”的喊声。

subtitles.en: No!
subtitles.zh: 不！

subtitles.en: IMTIAZ TYAB: It's unclear, what was happening, but at one point, a cabin crew member shouts for passengers to sit down-- Sit down!
subtitles.zh: 目前不清楚当时发生了什么，但在某一刻，一名机组人员大喊让乘客坐下——“坐下！”

subtitles.en: IMTIAZ TYAB: --with someone heard saying, he's a doctor.
subtitles.zh: 有人听见说“他是医生”。

subtitles.en: MAN: I'm a doctor.
subtitles.zh: 我是医生。

subtitles.en: IMTIAZ TYAB: As cabin crew members fumbled with medical equipment, the sound of screams, including of small children heard in the background.
subtitles.zh: 机组人员手忙脚乱地摆弄医疗设备时，背景里能听到尖叫声，包括小孩子的哭声。

subtitles.en: Speaking publicly for the first time, Captain Smit Machchhar, bandaged and lying in his hospital bed, said he couldn't let his passengers die, even as he was fighting for his own life.
subtitles.zh: 机长斯密特·马赫查尔首次公开发声，他缠着绷带躺在医院病床上说，即使自己在为生命抗争，也不能让乘客丧命。

subtitles.en: He told Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi, "I knew for sure, this is the one last push, Smit.
subtitles.zh: 他告诉印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪：“我很确定，斯密特，这是最后一搏。

subtitles.en: Just do it.
subtitles.zh: 只管去做。

subtitles.en: The door's right there."
subtitles.zh: 门就在那里。”

subtitles.en: Captain Machchhar, who was stabbed, could be seen lying on the ground, crying out in pain.
subtitles.zh: 可以看到被刺伤的机长马赫查尔躺在地上，痛苦地喊叫。

subtitles.en: My head is spinning.
subtitles.zh: 我头晕目眩。

subtitles.en: It is hurting.
subtitles.zh: 很疼。

subtitles.en: IMTIAZ TYAB: A reserve crew on board was able to take control of the plane and later landed, saving the lives of all 174 on board.
subtitles.zh: 机上的一名备用机组人员设法控制了飞机，随后降落，救下了机上全部174人的生命。

subtitles.en: And tonight, for the first time, a senior UAE government official has called the flydubai attack, quote, "terrorist act," and said Captain Machchhar is a true hero.
subtitles.zh: 今晚，一位阿联酋高级政府官员首次称这起flydubai袭击为“恐怖主义行为”，并表示马赫查尔机长是真正的英雄。

subtitles.en: The attacker pilot is now an Emirati custody, and will later be questioned by Israeli investigators.
subtitles.zh: 实施袭击的飞行员目前被阿联酋拘押，之后将接受以色列调查人员的讯问。

subtitles.en: Tony.
subtitles.zh: 托尼。

subtitles.en: Imtiaz, thank you.
subtitles.zh: 伊姆蒂亚兹，谢谢。

subtitles.en: President Trump is back on the campaign trail tonight hoping to give Republicans a boost ahead of the midterm elections.
subtitles.zh: 特朗普总统今晚重返竞选活动，希望在中期选举前给共和党人提振。

subtitles.en: Here's Senior White House correspondent Weijia Jiang.
subtitles.zh: 以下是白宫资深记者江维佳的报道。

subtitles.en: WEIJIA JIANG: Tonight, President Trump is campaigning in deep red Mobile, Alabama, his third visit to a Republican-led state in two days.
subtitles.zh: 今晚，特朗普总统在深红的阿拉巴马州莫比尔市竞选，这是他两天内第三次来到共和党主导的州。

subtitles.en: We're making a lot of progress.
subtitles.zh: 我们正在取得很大进展。

subtitles.en: When I go there, we win.
subtitles.zh: 我去那里，我们就赢。

subtitles.en: If I don't go there, we would not do as well.
subtitles.zh: 如果我不去那里，我们表现不会那么好。

subtitles.en: WEIJIA JIANG: But the president's approval rating is at near record lows, in large part because of his handling of the economy.
subtitles.zh: 但总统的支持率接近历史最低点，很大程度上是因为他对经济的处理方式。

subtitles.en: In Theodore, Alabama, this food bank says it is dealing with a spike in requests for help after Trump's Big, Beautiful Bill changed eligibility requirements for food stamp benefits, including expanded age limits for workers and fewer carve-outs for veterans.
subtitles.zh: 在阿拉巴马州西奥多，这家食物银行表示，在特朗普的“大而美法案”改变了食品券福利的资格要求之后，寻求帮助的请求激增，这些改变包括扩大了劳动者的年龄限制，并减少了对退伍军人的特殊豁免。

subtitles.en: I was going to slow down a little.
subtitles.zh: 我本来想稍微放慢一点。

subtitles.en: WEIJIA JIANG: Michael Ledger is the CEO of Feeding the Gulf Coast.
subtitles.zh: 迈克尔·莱杰是Feeding the Gulf Coast的首席执行官。

subtitles.en: He tells us, as the need increases, so do costs, as the Iran war drives up diesel prices, which these trucks use to make deliveries six days a week.
subtitles.zh: 他告诉我们，随着需求增加，成本也在上升，因为伊朗战争推高了柴油价格，而这些卡车每周有六天要用来送货。

subtitles.en: So you can imagine, the amount of fuel we're using.
subtitles.zh: 所以你可以想象我们的燃油消耗量有多大。

subtitles.en: Every dollar that goes into that tank extra is not going into food and other supports that we're hoping to provide.
subtitles.zh: 每多花在油箱上的一美元，都无法用于我们原本希望提供的食物和其他支持。

subtitles.en: WEIJIA JIANG: With diesel and gas prices soaring, Trump announced Europe will release diesel from its stockpile.
subtitles.zh: 随着柴油和汽油价格飙升，特朗普宣布欧洲将从其储备中释放柴油。

subtitles.en: President Trump is speaking tonight here, at the University of South Alabama, where three students were arrested in the last 24 hours accused of making threats against the president.
subtitles.zh: 特朗普总统今晚将在这里的南阿拉巴马大学发表讲话，过去24小时里，该校有三名学生因被控对总统发出威胁而被捕。

subtitles.en: The FBI traced social media messages, allegedly posted by the suspects, that included language about ending Trump's life.
subtitles.zh: 联邦调查局追踪了据称由嫌疑人发布的社交媒体信息，其中包含要结束特朗普生命的言论。

subtitles.en: Tony.
subtitles.zh: 托尼。

subtitles.en: Weijia, thank you.
subtitles.zh: 维佳，谢谢。

subtitles.en: Also, today, I spoke with Republican Senator Ted Cruz of Texas about the tight Senate race in his home state, and about the bipartisan Protect College Sports Act that he helped push through the Senate.
subtitles.zh: 另外，今天我与得克萨斯州共和党参议员特德·克鲁兹谈到了他所在州竞争激烈的参议院选举，以及他帮助在参议院推动的两党《保护大学体育法案》。

subtitles.en: There's lots there.
subtitles.zh: 里面内容很多。

subtitles.en: You can find the full conversation on our website.
subtitles.zh: 完整对话可以在我们网站上找到。

subtitles.en: We also have news tonight on the condition of Christa Pike, the convicted killer who survived a failed execution in Tennessee this week.
subtitles.zh: 我们今晚还有关于克里斯塔·派克状况的消息，这名被判有罪的杀人犯本周在田纳西州一次失败的死刑执行中幸存下来。

subtitles.en: She is unconscious and on a hospital ventilator, that's according to her lawyers, as doctors now try to save her life.
subtitles.zh: 据她的律师说，她目前昏迷，靠医院呼吸机维持生命，医生正在努力挽救她。

subtitles.en: They say the two supposedly lethal injections she got left her arms burned and blistered.
subtitles.zh: 他们说，她接受的两剂本应致命的注射让她的双臂烧伤、起了水泡。

subtitles.en: Justice Samuel Alito says he's troubled by criticism of the Supreme Court.
subtitles.zh: 大法官塞缪尔·阿利托表示，他对最高法院受到的批评感到不安。

subtitles.en: But in a rare interview ahead of the publication of his book, So Ordered, he tells our Chief Legal correspondent Jan Crawford that the views of others, including President Trump, do not influence his decisions.
subtitles.zh: 但在他的著作《如此裁定》出版前的一次罕见采访中，他告诉我们的首席法律记者简·克劳福德，包括特朗普总统在内的其他人的观点不会影响他的决定。

subtitles.en: JAN CRAWFORD: Would you decide these cases the same way if it weren't Donald Trump in the White House?
subtitles.zh: 简·克劳福德：如果白宫里的不是唐纳德·特朗普，你会以同样的方式裁决这些案件吗？

subtitles.en: I absolutely, sincerely believe that I would.
subtitles.zh: 我绝对、真诚地相信我会。

subtitles.en: I'm not trying to decide cases to help President Trump, and I have not decided cases in the past to help or hurt any other president or presidential administration.
subtitles.zh: 我并不是在试图通过裁决案件来帮助特朗普总统，过去我也从未以帮助或伤害任何其他总统或总统行政机构为目的来裁决案件。

subtitles.en: TONY DOKOUPIL: We will have much more of Jan's interview Monday, the day the Supreme Court's new term begins, on the CBS Evening News.
subtitles.zh: 周一，也就是最高法院新庭期开始的那天，我们将在 CBS 晚间新闻中带来更多 Jan 的采访内容。

subtitles.en: There's new reporting coming out on 60 Minutes about whether artificial intelligence is coming for your job or the job of someone you know.
subtitles.zh: 《60分钟》将播出一篇新报道，探讨人工智能是否会抢走你或你认识的人的工作。

subtitles.en: Correspondent Jon Wertheim speaks with Clara Shih, a former top AI executive, about what could be coming.
subtitles.zh: 记者 Jon Wertheim 与前顶级 AI 高管 Clara Shih 聊了聊接下来可能发生的事。

subtitles.en: Traditionally, the tasks that you might assign to a young person, maybe doing some market research or creating the first draft of a memo, AI is just really good at doing those now.
subtitles.zh: 以往你可能会交给年轻人的任务，比如做市场调研或写备忘录初稿，现在 AI 已经特别擅长了。

subtitles.en: JON WERTHEIM: Until January, Clara Shih was overseeing major AI divisions at Salesforce and then, Meta.
subtitles.zh: 直到 1 月，Clara Shih 先后在 Salesforce 和 Meta 负责主要的 AI 部门。

subtitles.en: You've seen how powerful this can be.
subtitles.zh: 你见识过它有多强大吧。

subtitles.en: Oh, yeah.
subtitles.zh: 哦，是啊。

subtitles.en: I've seen us go from previously requiring dozens of people to conceive of a product, prototype it, build it, to now being able to do that with one or two or three people using AI agents.
subtitles.zh: 我亲眼见证我们从以前需要几十个人来构思产品、做原型、把它做出来，到现在用 AI 智能体，一两个人或三个人就能完成。

subtitles.en: Yikes.
subtitles.zh: 哎呀。

subtitles.en: Jon Wertheim joins us now.
subtitles.zh: Jon Wertheim 现在来到演播室。

subtitles.en: Jon, great to have you here.
subtitles.zh: Jon，欢迎你来节目。

subtitles.en: How do we get our kids to keep doing homework if there's no jobs in the future?
subtitles.zh: 如果将来没有工作了，我们怎么让孩子还愿意写作业呢？

subtitles.en: Yeah, I mean, one of the ironies is that AI now is taboo in high schools and colleges.
subtitles.zh: 是啊，其中一个讽刺之处是，如今 AI 在高中和大学里成了禁忌。

subtitles.en: What does that mean, though?
subtitles.zh: 但这意味着什么呢？

subtitles.en: That means that when these kids come out of school, they don't have the AI skills.
subtitles.zh: 这意味着这些孩子走出校门时，并不具备 AI 技能。

subtitles.en: So it's a real issue, and the 20-somethings are the demographic most affected.
subtitles.zh: 所以这确实是个问题，20 多岁的年轻人是受影响最大的群体。

subtitles.en: Jon Wertheim, thank you very much.
subtitles.zh: Jon Wertheim，非常感谢。

subtitles.en: Looking forward to this piece.
subtitles.zh: 期待这篇报道。

subtitles.en: You can see Jon's full report Sunday on 60 Minutes right here on CBS and Paramount+.
subtitles.zh: 你可以在周日《60分钟》看到 Jon 的完整报道，就在 CBS 和 Paramount+。

subtitles.en: Still ahead on the broadcast tonight, the violent protests by students angry over conditions at their schools.
subtitles.zh: 今晚节目还将关注学生因不满学校条件而发起的暴力抗议。

subtitles.en: A wave of violent protests sweeping France, led by students apparently outraged after years of overcrowded, underfunded schools.
subtitles.zh: 一波暴力抗议正席卷法国，带头的是学生们，他们对学校多年来拥挤、资金不足的状况感到愤怒。

subtitles.en: Senior Foreign correspondent Holly Williams reports tonight, from just outside Paris.
subtitles.zh: 高级驻外记者 Holly Williams 今晚从巴黎郊外发来报道。

subtitles.en: HOLLY WILLIAMS: Today, French riot police clashed with angry students around the country.
subtitles.zh: 今天，法国防暴警察在全国各地与愤怒的学生发生冲突。

subtitles.en: The protests erupted last week in the Paris area and have now spread to more than 500 schools, according to the French government.
subtitles.zh: 据法国政府称，抗议活动上周在巴黎地区爆发，现已蔓延到 500 多所学校。

subtitles.en: The students' grievances range from dilapidated buildings to the quality of teaching.
subtitles.zh: 学生们的不满包括破旧的校舍和教学质量等问题。

subtitles.en: "We have cockroaches crawling around the classroom," said this student, "as well as rats."
subtitles.zh: 这名学生说：“教室里有蟑螂到处爬，还有老鼠。”

subtitles.en: Schools have been barricaded and burned.
subtitles.zh: 一些学校被设障封锁并遭纵火。

subtitles.en: France's Education minister says that 65 school workers have been injured, including 40 principals.
subtitles.zh: 法国教育部长称，已有 65 名学校工作人员受伤，包括 40 名校长。

subtitles.en: And the Interior Ministry says around 5,000 have been arrested.
subtitles.zh: 内政部表示，约有 5000 人被捕。

subtitles.en: Many of them teenagers.
subtitles.zh: 其中很多是青少年。

subtitles.en: There's a presidential election here in France next year, and these protests are shaping up to be a campaign issue.
subtitles.zh: 法国明年有总统选举，这些抗议正在成为一个竞选议题。

subtitles.en: Students at this Parisian school, the Lycée Paul Éluard, were among the first to protest.
subtitles.zh: Paul Éluard 高中的学生是最早参与抗议的学生之一。

subtitles.en: They barricaded the entrance and lit fires in trash cans.
subtitles.zh: 他们封锁了入口，并在垃圾桶里点火。

subtitles.en: Tonight, they've gone home, but there's no sign these protests are going to stop.
subtitles.zh: 今晚他们已经回家了，但没有迹象表明这些抗议活动会停止。

subtitles.en: Tony.
subtitles.zh: Tony。

subtitles.en: Holly, thank you.
subtitles.zh: Holly，谢谢。

subtitles.en: Still ahead, the new tiger cubs with very different personalities.
subtitles.zh: 接下来，还有个性截然不同的新虎宝宝。

subtitles.en: We're back with a close call caught on live TV.
subtitles.zh: 我们回来继续，看一段直播中拍到的惊险瞬间。

subtitles.en: A reporter in Monterrey, Mexico, was covering a small rockslide near a busy highway when an SUV lost control on the wet pavement, spun around the rock pile right into the reporter and her cameraman, who were bruised and scared, but not seriously hurt.
subtitles.zh: 墨西哥蒙特雷的一名记者正在报道繁忙公路附近的一处小型岩崩，突然一辆 SUV 在湿滑路面上失控，绕过石堆，径直撞向记者和她的摄像师。两人受了擦伤、受到惊吓，但没有受重伤。

subtitles.en: And a 6-year-old slipped away from his father at a carnival in Mexico, and this is where he ended up, dangling from a Ferris wheel, after apparently, sneaking in and grabbing on to the edge of a car.
subtitles.zh: 墨西哥一个嘉年华上，一名 6 岁男孩从父亲身边溜走，结果就变成了这样：他吊在摩天轮上。显然他是偷偷溜进去，抓住了车厢边缘。

subtitles.en: Fortunately, he held on until workers could stop the ride and retrieve him safely.
subtitles.zh: 幸运的是，他一直抓着，直到工作人员停下设施，把他安全救了下来。

subtitles.en: And a pair of tiger cubs has been born at the Fort Worth Zoo.
subtitles.zh: 沃思堡动物园还出生了一对虎宝宝。

subtitles.en: They are each about the size of a large pumpkin and represent new hope for the Sumatran tiger species, critically endangered in the wild.
subtitles.zh: 它们每只大约有一个大南瓜那么大，为在野外极度濒危的苏门答腊虎种群带来了新希望。

subtitles.en: One of the cubs is a spitfire, according to the zoo, while the other likes alone time, often sneaking off to a neighboring barn stall to nap.
subtitles.zh: 动物园说，其中一只虎宝宝是个暴脾气，另一只则喜欢独处，经常溜到旁边的谷仓隔间去打盹。

subtitles.en: And Steve Hartman is up next On The Road, with why cancer patients may treasure this man almost as much as their doctors.
subtitles.zh: 接下来是 Steve Hartman 的《在路上》，讲的是为什么癌症患者可能几乎像珍惜医生一样珍惜这个男人。

subtitles.en: It's a Friday.
subtitles.zh: 今天是星期五。

subtitles.en: Time to go On The Road, where Steve Hartman learned, you don't need to be a doctor to be a healer.
subtitles.zh: 又到了《在路上》时间，Steve Hartman 发现：不一定要当医生，也能成为治愈者。

subtitles.en: STEVE HARTMAN: 41-year-old Kate Fink is a breast cancer survivor.
subtitles.zh: 41 岁的 Kate Fink 是乳腺癌幸存者。

subtitles.en: A success, she credits, in no small part to one particular person at her care center.
subtitles.zh: 她认为，这一成功很大程度上要归功于她护理中心里的一位特别的人。

subtitles.en: Absolutely.
subtitles.zh: 绝对是这样。

subtitles.en: I mean, he's made an impact.
subtitles.zh: 我的意思是，他确实带来了影响。

subtitles.en: Not just me, but so many other people.
subtitles.zh: 不只是对我，对很多其他人也是如此。

subtitles.en: STEVE HARTMAN: So, who is this miracle worker?
subtitles.zh: 那么，这位奇迹创造者是谁呢？

subtitles.en: Probably, the last worker you'd expect.
subtitles.zh: 很可能是你最意想不到的工作人员。

subtitles.en: How you been?
subtitles.zh: 你最近怎么样？

subtitles.en: Good to see you.
subtitles.zh: 见到你真好。

subtitles.en: STEVE HARTMAN: His name is Jon Avery, and he's the hospital valet.
subtitles.zh: 他叫 Jon Avery，是医院的代客泊车员。

subtitles.en: All right.
subtitles.zh: 好的。

subtitles.en: There's always an exception to the rule, so I'm one of the exceptions.
subtitles.zh: 凡事总有例外，我就是那个例外。

subtitles.en: STEVE HARTMAN: John parks cars here at the Roswell Cancer Center in Buffalo, New York.
subtitles.zh: John 在纽约布法罗的 Roswell 癌症中心为人们泊车。

subtitles.en: Curbside service, ma'am.
subtitles.zh: 路边服务，女士。

subtitles.en: STEVE HARTMAN: And he does it with such joy-- High five, champ.
subtitles.zh: 他做这件事时特别开心——来击个掌，冠军。

subtitles.en: STEVE HARTMAN: --such contagious optimism, that if not for the wheelchairs, you'd never know, some of these people were even sick.
subtitles.zh: ——那种乐观特别有感染力，要不是因为轮椅，你根本不会知道这些人里有些人其实病着。

subtitles.en: Just a shining lighthouse of hope-- Take your time.
subtitles.zh: 就是一座闪亮的希望灯塔——慢慢来。

subtitles.en: STEVE HARTMAN: --in the dark storm of their diagnoses.
subtitles.zh: ——在他们诊断结果带来的黑暗风暴里。

subtitles.en: You're an angel.
subtitles.zh: 你是个天使。

subtitles.en: I appreciate that, ma'am.
subtitles.zh: 谢谢您，女士。

subtitles.en: STEVE HARTMAN: When you're interacting with patients, what are you trying to achieve?
subtitles.zh: 当你和病人互动时，你想做到什么？

subtitles.en: Just to have a meaningful encounter.
subtitles.zh: 就是想有一次真正有意义的交流。

subtitles.en: That's not hollow.
subtitles.zh: 那不是空话。

subtitles.en: STEVE HARTMAN: For Kate, he just kept telling her, day after day, to keep pushing, saying, you got this.
subtitles.zh: 对凯特来说，他就是日复一日地告诉她要坚持下去，说‘你能行’。

subtitles.en: And after a while, you believed it?
subtitles.zh: 过了一阵子，你就信了？

subtitles.en: Mm-hmm.
subtitles.zh: 嗯哼。

subtitles.en: Yeah.
subtitles.zh: 对。

subtitles.en: It's just, your mindset just changes.
subtitles.zh: 就是，你的心态会改变。

subtitles.en: STEVE HARTMAN: Kate says, she was so grateful.
subtitles.zh: 凯特说她非常感激。

subtitles.en: That I wanted to do something nice for him.
subtitles.zh: 以至于我想为他做点好事。

subtitles.en: STEVE HARTMAN: At one point, John mentioned Kate that he was saving his money.
subtitles.zh: 有一次，约翰跟凯特提到他在攒钱。

subtitles.en: Really wanted to go to a Buffalo Bills game.
subtitles.zh: 特别想去看一场布法罗比尔队的比赛。

subtitles.en: It was just a passing comment, but one that Kate couldn't pass up.
subtitles.zh: 那只是随口一提，但凯特却没法不当回事。

subtitles.en: So last month, she and her work colleagues, at a local car dealership, raised money, made calls, and got the tickets, with field passes.
subtitles.zh: 于是上个月，她和当地一家汽车经销店的同事们筹了钱、打了电话，弄到了门票，还带场地通行证。

subtitles.en: Getting ready.
subtitles.zh: 准备好啦。

subtitles.en: I've got to find my outfit.
subtitles.zh: 我得找到我的行头。

subtitles.en: STEVE HARTMAN: John was beyond grateful.
subtitles.zh: 约翰感激得不得了。

subtitles.en: But he says, it was hardly necessary.
subtitles.zh: 但他说，这其实没太必要。

subtitles.en: I serve people.
subtitles.zh: 我服务他人。

subtitles.en: That's what I do.
subtitles.zh: 这就是我所做的。

subtitles.en: And if I ain't got nothing else in the world, that means anything to anybody, I know, I can live in service.
subtitles.zh: 哪怕我在这个世界上没有别的什么东西能给别人带来意义，我知道，我还能靠服务他人活着。

subtitles.en: Appreciate you, always.
subtitles.zh: 永远感谢你。

subtitles.en: STEVE HARTMAN: And that's how a hospital worker makes people better-- We good, now.
subtitles.zh: 这就是一位医院工作者如何让人变得更好——我们现在没事了。
